status: independent geometry review, not strength approval

dimensions_mm.rotor_holes: 6 M3 clearance D3.4 PCD27 phase0; D5.8 counterbore

notes: Tool access is before OB outer cover installation. OA hardware heads are modeled without hex recess; tool check stops at nominal standard socket depth and excludes its own screw head.
M3 motor engagement is checked with a D2.4 smooth core probe, not the true helical thread. Actual manufacturer depth5 leaves nominal1 bottom clearance.
2.1 radial web around six deep counterbores is geometric clearance only. Torsion, fatigue and tightening-bearing capacity require material/fillet/preload analysis.
O neck and bearing load path include 1.975 radial pilot lip before y=S+1. That lip locates; axial screw load passes through the 12mm hub after the cup floor.
No separate locating dowel has been added to OA by this review; supplied D35 pilot plus bolt circle aligns the current crank design.
